items: 6 scholarships every Indian student should know
scenes.say: Want to study abroad for free? Here are six scholarships every Indian student should know.

items: 1-year master's
Tuition, travel, visa + monthly allowance
Need 2,800 hours (about 2 years) of work experience
Applications: usually August to October
scenes.say: One. Chevening, in the UK. A one year master's with tuition, travel, visa and a monthly allowance. You need about two years of work experience. Applications usually open in August.

items: 1-year master's at a UK university
Full tuition, airfare + £1,712 a month (£2,000 in London)
For students who can't afford UK study · return to India after
Apply via Ministry of Education + CSC online portal
scenes.say: Two. The Commonwealth Master's Scholarship, also in the UK. A one year master's with full tuition, airfare and a monthly stipend. It is for students who cannot afford UK study, and you apply through India's Ministry of Education.

items: Master's for up to 2 years
Tuition, living costs, air travel
Degree with 55% + 3 years of work experience
scenes.say: Three. Fulbright Nehru master's fellowships, in the USA. Up to two years, covering tuition, living costs and air travel. You need fifty five percent in your degree and three years of work experience.

items: Government of India · 125 awards a year
For SC and other listed categories
Family income up to ₹8 lakh · age under 35 · 60% marks
Tuition + living allowance for master's or PhD
scenes.say: Four. The National Overseas Scholarship from the Government of India, for S C and other listed categories. Family income up to eight lakh rupees, age under thirty five, and sixty percent marks. It pays tuition and a living allowance.

items: Master's in 2 or more European countries
Covers travel, visa + living allowance
Apply to each programme, usually October to January
scenes.say: Five. Erasmus Mundus, in Europe. Study one master's in two or more countries, with travel, visa and a living allowance. Apply directly to each programme, usually from October to January.

items: Public universities: low or no tuition
DAAD scholarships for master's and PhD
Check daad.in for open programmes
scenes.say: Six. D A A D, in Germany. Most public universities charge low or no tuition, and D A A D scholarships help with master's and P h D study.
